note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list; guide text is original, written in-session 20 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: Finish the other 54 trophies; this platinum pops automatically once the last one lands. [1]
No separate task exists for it — track the 54 in the checklist above and clear the final stragglers in Stage 7. [2]

trophies.name: A Long Road
guide: Work the 100% checklist in three groups: Story & Tasks (12 lines), Exploration & Activities (20 lines) and Discovery (3 lines). [4]

Clear the agreed thresholds first — card sets 15/18, WAiNK 100, stunts 300/397, challenges 70/80, vehicles 200/277, animals 100/255, flamingos 100/125 and meditations 15/18 — then finish the lines that must be complete, including all robberies, all 33 underwater discoveries, all shooting-range golds, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. [1]
The checklist weights are single-source: GTABase alone gives 45% / 45% / 10% to the three groups, so treat the split as a guide, not a verified fact. [4]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Chain jumps, near-misses and airtime anywhere in Leonida; every stunt type counts toward the 250. [1]
The 100% checklist needs 300 of 397 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. [4]
Count progress in the counter below and in the 100% panel — the two targets differ. [1]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the count runs to 9, not to a win in each. [1]
Sampling is enough: play one round or one attempt of each type and the trophy pops. [6]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Visit the two ranges — Griffin in Vice City and Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn — and work the 12 challenges until each shows a gold medal. [1]
The agreed total is 42 gold medals, confirmed across PowerPyx, Push Square, GTABase and GamesRadar+. [8]
One source splits the 42 as 18 at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch; use that only as a rough split, not a verified fact. [4]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations to pop the trophy. [1]
The 100% checklist separately needs 42 drone time trials across those 14 locations, so keep racing after the trophy pops if you are chasing A Long Road. [1]
Track both numbers in the counter below — locations won and trials cleared are different counts. [3]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count. [1]
Mix race types and locations; each new race you win ticks the counter once. [6]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Take Cal up on a fishing challenge and beat his catch. [1]
Fishing challenges unlock through the fishing activity; keep accepting them until Cal appears as your opponent. [6]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Play any arcade game through to its end. [1]
Finishing one game is enough — you do not need a high score. [6]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. [10]
Only about 4 strands are confirmed by name so far — Kirk, Yago, Pilot Pete and one more — so the rest have no verified trigger yet. [1]

Treat the timed Yago race in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon) as a deadline: do it when it appears, because some guides warn it may lock Yago's strand, while PowerPyx holds that all strands stay open after the story — so do it early and do not test the dispute. [12]
Label: WATCH / may be missable — not a firm missable, but not cleared either. [4]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: Meditate at the balcony spot at Jason's house on the morning after the mission Down to Earth, when Lucia invites you from the kitchen — this spot exists only in Chapter 1. [1]
Then meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida; there are 18 spots in 10 locations, and the final spot on the peak of Mount Kalaga only appears once the others are done. [1]
Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 and keep a manual Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops — that is the safe play every guide agrees on. [1]

Dispute, both versions shown — Version A: the trophy needs all 18 meditations [1]; Version B: it needs only 15, the same count the 100% checklist needs [1]. Whether the balcony meditation counts is also disputed: PowerPyx did it and the trophy popped but wrote 'pending confirmation' [1], OutputLag states it counts [5], eGamers reports the walkthrough author was not sure [7], and Push Square lists no missable at all [8]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Take Bret's hunting work and track down the unique animal he asks for. [1]
Studying animals counts separately toward the 100% checklist, which needs 100 of 255 animals studied — keep the field guide open while you hunt. [4]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Collect cards and finish 3 full sets; there are 480 cards in 18 sets across Leonida. [1]
The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy is a waypoint, not the end of card hunting. [4]
Use the counter below per set and prioritise sets whose cards cluster in one region. [1]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations; 112 spots exist, so you can skip a dozen awkward ones. [4]
The count is per location, so a repeat visit to the same spot adds nothing. [1]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete any 50 challenges from the challenge list. [1]
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 challenges, so keep clearing them after this trophy pops. [1]
Pick the shortest challenges first and let the counter below track the 50-target and the 70-target separately. [3]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Build a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and escape the search area together. [1]
Losing the heat with your partner present is what counts — escaping alone does not pop it. [6]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping the same Wanted Level running through all three. [1]
Plan the route first: three shops close together, a fast getaway car parked outside each one. [6]
If the Wanted Level clears between robberies the chain breaks and the count restarts. [1]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 vehicles by getting close enough for each base model to register. [1]
The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning traffic after this trophy pops. [4]
Variety matters, not repeats: the same model twice adds nothing. [1]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Enter Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range, then drop all 5 before the effect ends. [1]
Set it up deliberately: draw a group into a tight space before triggering Combat Focus, rather than hoping for it in a random firefight. [6]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Steal a parked passenger plane at VCIA and fly it roughly 1 km to make the unscheduled departure. [1]

Do it as soon as you can reach VCIA in the story — whether the airfield window stays open in free roam is disputed, with some guides listing this as the second possibly missable and others only as a watch. [4]
Label: WATCH — disputed window; treat it as time-sensitive until a source confirms free-roam access. [12]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
guide: Face Rhinos (tanks) and survive the encounter the trophy asks for — the description itself is the hint. [10]
Bring heavy weapons and cover; tanks punish a straight charge. [1]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point in the robbery. [1]
Go in quiet: no alarms, no spotted cameras, no guard raising the alarm before you leave. [6]
If you are spotted, leave and reset the attempt rather than fighting through it. [1]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. [1]
The 100% checklist needs 8 vaults, so three more vaults remain after this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. [4]
Escape cleanly each time — the count only ticks on a completed escape. [1]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an armored truck and escape with the take. [1]
Hit the truck, grab the cash, then break the Wanted Level before the trophy can count the escape. [6]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: Make choices that move your Criminal Profile; the profile tracks them across the whole playthrough. [1]
The figure of 500 actions is single-source: it comes from GamesRadar+ as an editorial addition in square brackets and from GTABase, with no independent second source confirming the count. [9]
What counts as one 'action' is not confirmed anywhere, so play normally, make decisive choices, and do not grind a number no source can verify. [4]
Warning: the 'Irredeemable' Criminal Profile status is permanent once reached — PowerPyx and GTABase agree on that, so weigh choices before you push the profile to its extreme. [1]
